Megan Quigley

I care about helping people get the support they need. At Lincoln Financial, I worked on financial wellness benefits; at NBCUniversal, I helped employees navigate HR policies and benefits. Those experiences, along with studying sociology at Lehigh University, left me asking why support can exist on paper and still be so hard to use.

I want to help close that gap. I research and write about public benefits to make complicated programs easier to understand, show where people get stuck, and explore how things could work better. My mission is to help turn available support into something people can actually use. Outside of these projects, I’m usually adding a restaurant to Beli, working through the NYT Mini, or finding my next read on Libby.
